text.text_excerpt: All the meh reviews had me feeling a little dubious about this place, but my roommate and I went here for breakfast yesterday, and we adored it. The service was impeccable; our waiter was super sweet! The ambiance of the place is old school and modern and the names on the menu are super cute (WOMELETTE?!) My roommate ordered the TREE HUGGER BENNIE: 3 poached eggs, mushrooms, tomato, spinach on toasted English muffin, with hollandaise sauce, and I got the GULF COAST OMELET and added spinach: fresh local crabmeat, marinated smoked feta, tomato, fresh herbs. Mine was $10, my roomate's was $11, they also had some delectable-looking cakes; each slice was about 5 inches tall... I'll be back.

I came here upon the recommendation of a friend who lives in the neighborhood. She had gone there for breakfast a few days earlier and found the food good and reasonably priced. I took a look at the the yelp reviews for this place and was a bit skeptical, but being very hungry and in the area I went with the same friend, plus two more, to dinner on a Sunday night. Well, after reading the previous reviews I feel compelled to write one because my experience was quite different from everyone else's so far! We were seated almost immediately. The hostess was lovely. The waitress came out immediately and took our drink orders. She was very knowledgeable about the menu and took time to answer ou...

Just had brunch. No complaints here! Great food, nice staff, and great environment. It's a great Neighborhood spot to eat and place to bring out of town guests. Don't understand most of the bad reviews. The service was kinda slow...but it was brunch and i wasn't in any rush. People gotta chill. Its not in the quarter and caters to a local crowd...many of whom are in no particular rush.
